name: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil
summary: In Malaka'jin, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil turns dark voodoo against the Horde's enemies. The Darkspear troll mystic lives in a cave in the southern Stonetalon Mountains and is a longtime comrade of Darsok Swiftdagger and the shadow hunter Rokhan.

sections.title: The Hermit of Malaka'jin
sections.body: In a cave east of Malaka'jin, Jin'Zil practices the ancient arts of jungle trolls, far from his tribe's coastal home. Bubbling cauldrons and captive prisoners fill his cavern. He gathers exotic reagents from the Stonetalon crags, weaving blessings and curses to defend the Horde's mountain camp.

sections.title: A Trusted Veteran
sections.body: Jin'Zil is an old friend of senior Horde scouts Darsok Swiftdagger and the shadow hunter Rokhan. Darsok leads frontline skirmishes against night elves and harpies. Jin'Zil fights the war through spirit and alchemy, using forest magic and volatile voodoo to weaken threats before they reach the camp gates.

faq.q: Where can I find Witch Doctor Jin'Zil?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil lives in a cave on the eastern side of Malaka'jin, a Horde settlement in the southern pass of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What is Jin'Zil's connection to Rokhan and Darsok Swiftdagger?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil is an old, trusted friend of Darsok Swiftdagger and the shadow hunter Rokhan. Scouts across Stonetalon rely on his magic when unusual threats arise.

faq.q: Why does Jin'Zil have prisoners in his cave?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil keeps captive enemies caged in his cavern workshop. He uses captives and raw reagents to test curses, divine portents, and craft defensive voodoo for the settlement.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does he give to Horde adventurers?
faq.answer: He sends travelers across Stonetalon to gather mystical components for his forest magic and voodoo rituals.

angles.text: As a troll, you see Jin'Zil carry Darkspear witch doctor practices into Kalimdor's rugged wilderness. He has deep ties to prominent figures such as Rokhan.
As a member of the Horde, you can rely on Jin'Zil for occult defense and intelligence support alongside the outpost's scouts as the Horde secures Stonetalon's southern paths.
